versionImpact.rationale: The release preserves existing image names and consumer contracts while completing Buildchain routing, package-manager, font-scaling, and release-evidence behavior.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: The existing v1.2 image family now uses the standard Buildchain v2.12 alpha and stable router with separate locked contracts and unchanged image identifiers.
The existing Node 24 image exposes the repository-declared pnpm toolchain through Corepack without removing or renaming an existing runtime surface.
The existing LaTeX image adds scalable CM-Super fonts so microtype font expansion works with the default Computer Modern family while preserving existing TeX entrypoints.
Stable publication now supplies the required surface impact ledger to the Buildchain release passport without changing the published OCI family contract.

The comparator pilot binds declared jobs and tiers to a digest-locked allowlisted workload adapter, adds a non-test PostgreSQL Phase A plan and tamper-rejecting offline receipts, and preserves existing unscored smoke commands and published image identifiers.

recovery.rollback: Use the previous exact release tag or previous floating channel ref.
